reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for persistent, versioned agent memory and harness-state evolution, including trajectory-derived entries, prompt injection, review and benchmark loops, rollback, and skill mounting.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 持久化管理代理记忆与提示内容，并通过审查、评估和回滚机制持续演化 harness 状态。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that persistently manages agent memories and prompt-related state with review, evaluation, and rollback workflows.

capabilities: persists and versions prompt notes, memories, skills, and subagent specifications
injects stored entries into the agent system prompt
provides model-facing tools and /evolve commands to add, update, delete, and roll back entries
reads and writes local state, logs, backups, and imported stores
can hot-mount stored skills as live plugins
